description: Network exploration tool and security/port scanner.

option.name: --adler32
tip: Use the deprecated Adler32 SCTP checksum instead of CRC32C.

option.name: --allports
tip: Do not exclude any ports from version detection.

option.name: --append-output
tip: Append to output files instead of overwriting them.

option.name: --badsum
tip: Send packets with a bogus TCP, UDP, or SCTP checksum.

option.name: --data
tip: Append custom binary data to sent packets.

option.name: --data-length
tip: Append random data to sent packets.

option.name: --data-string
tip: Append a custom ASCII string to sent packets.

option.name: --datadir
tip: Set the directory Nmap reads its data files from.

option.name: --debug
tip: Increase the debugging level.
Attach a level to set it directly (e.g. -d9), or repeat the option.

option.name: --defeat-icmp-ratelimit
tip: Ignore ICMP rate limiting to speed up UDP scans.

option.name: --defeat-rst-ratelimit
tip: Ignore RST rate limiting to speed up scans.

option.name: --disable-arp-ping
tip: Disable ARP and IPv6 Neighbor Discovery ping.

option.name: --discovery-ignore-rst
tip: Ignore TCP RST replies during host discovery.

option.name: --dns-servers
tip: Use the given DNS servers for queries.

option.name: --exclude
tip: Exclude hosts or networks from the scan.

option.name: --exclude-ports
tip: Exclude the given ports from the scan.

option.name: --excludefile
tip: Exclude targets listed in a file.

option.name: --help
tip: Print the help summary and exit.

option.name: --host-timeout
tip: Give up on a host after the given time.

option.name: --iflist
tip: Print host interfaces and routes, then exit.

option.name: --initial-rtt-timeout
tip: Set the initial probe round-trip timeout.

option.name: --ip-options
tip: Send packets with the given IP options.
Accepts R, T, U, L <route>, S <route>, or a hex string.

option.name: --max-hostgroup
tip: Set the maximum host group size.

option.name: --max-os-tries
tip: Set the maximum number of OS detection tries against a target.
The value must be between 1 and 50.

option.name: --max-parallelism
tip: Set the maximum number of parallel probes.

option.name: --max-rate
tip: Send packets no faster than the given rate.

option.name: --max-retries
tip: Set the maximum number of probe retransmissions.

option.name: --max-rtt-timeout
tip: Set the maximum probe round-trip timeout.

option.name: --max-scan-delay
tip: Set the maximum delay between probes.

option.name: --min-hostgroup
tip: Set the minimum host group size.

option.name: --min-parallelism
tip: Set the minimum number of parallel probes.

option.name: --min-rate
tip: Send packets no slower than the given rate.

option.name: --min-rtt-timeout
tip: Set the minimum probe round-trip timeout.

option.name: --mtu
tip: Fragment packets with the given MTU.
The value must be a multiple of 8.

option.name: --no-stylesheet
tip: Omit the XSL stylesheet declaration from XML output.

option.name: --noninteractive
tip: Disable runtime keyboard interaction.

option.name: --nsock-engine
tip: Force the given nsock I/O multiplexing engine.
Possible values: iocp, epoll, kqueue, poll, select.

option.name: --open
tip: Show only open or possibly open ports.

option.name: --osscan-guess
tip: Guess OS detection results more aggressively.

option.name: --osscan-limit
tip: Limit OS detection to promising targets.

option.name: --packet-trace
tip: Show every packet sent and received.

option.name: --port-ratio
tip: Scan ports more common than the given ratio.
The ratio must be between 0 and 1.

option.name: --privileged
tip: Assume the user is fully privileged.

option.name: --proxies
tip: Relay connections through a chain of HTTP or SOCKS4 proxies.

option.name: --randomize-hosts
tip: Randomize the target host order.

option.name: --reason
tip: Show the reason each host and port is in its state.

option.name: --resolve-all
tip: Scan every address a hostname resolves to.
By default only the first resolved address is scanned.

option.name: --resume
tip: Resume an aborted scan from its output file.

option.name: --scan-delay
tip: Wait at least the given time between probes.

option.name: --scanflags
tip: Customize the TCP flags used by the scan.
Accepts a number or a combination of URG, ACK, PSH, RST, SYN, and FIN.

option.name: --script
tip: Run a script scan with the given scripts, categories, or directories.
Accepts a comma-separated list.

next.name: all
tip: Run every script in the database.

next.name: auth
tip: Scripts that bypass or test authentication.

next.name: broadcast
tip: Scripts that discover hosts via broadcast.

next.name: brute
tip: Scripts that perform brute-force password auditing.

next.name: default
tip: Scripts run by default (the -sC set).

next.name: discovery
tip: Scripts that discover hosts and services.

next.name: dos
tip: Scripts that may cause denial of service; use with care.

next.name: exploit
tip: Scripts that exploit known vulnerabilities.

next.name: external
tip: Scripts that query external services.

next.name: fuzzer
tip: Scripts that fuzz services and protocols.

next.name: intrusive
tip: Scripts considered intrusive or risky.

next.name: malware
tip: Scripts that detect malware.

next.name: safe
tip: Scripts considered safe for most targets.

next.name: version
tip: Scripts that extend version detection.

next.name: vuln
tip: Scripts that check for known vulnerabilities.

option.name: --script-args
tip: Provide arguments to NSE scripts.

option.name: --script-args-file
tip: Load NSE script arguments from a file.

option.name: --script-help
tip: Show help about scripts.
Accepts the same specifications as --script.

option.name: --script-timeout
tip: Set a per-script timeout.

option.name: --script-trace
tip: Show all data sent and received by scripts.

option.name: --script-updatedb
tip: Update the script database.

option.name: --send-eth
tip: Send packets using raw ethernet frames.

option.name: --send-ip
tip: Send packets using raw IP sockets.

option.name: --servicedb
tip: Use a custom services file.

option.name: --source-port
tip: Use the given source port number.

option.name: --spoof-mac
tip: Spoof the MAC address.
Accepts a MAC, a prefix, a vendor name, or 0 for a random MAC.

option.name: --stats-every
tip: Print periodic timing statistics.

option.name: --stylesheet
tip: Set the XSL stylesheet used to transform XML output.

option.name: --system-dns
tip: Use the operating system's DNS resolver instead of Nmap's stub resolver.

option.name: --top-ports
tip: Scan the n most common ports.

option.name: --traceroute
tip: Trace the path to each host.

option.name: --ttl
tip: Set the IP time-to-live field.

option.name: --unique
tip: Scan each IP address only once.

option.name: --unprivileged
tip: Assume the user lacks raw socket privileges.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Increase the verbosity level.
Attach a level to set it directly (e.g. -v3), or repeat the option.

option.name: --version
tip: Print the Nmap version and exit.

option.name: --version-all
tip: Try every single version detection probe.
Equivalent to --version-intensity 9.

option.name: --version-intensity
tip: Set the version detection intensity from 0 to 9.
The default is 7.

option.name: --version-light
tip: Use light version detection.
Equivalent to --version-intensity 2.

option.name: --version-trace
tip: Show detailed version detection activity.

option.name: --versiondb
tip: Use a custom service probes file.

option.name: --webxml
tip: Use the Nmap.Org stylesheet for portable XML output.
Enable IPv6 scanning.

option.name: -A
tip: Enable aggressive scan options: OS detection, version detection, script scanning, and traceroute.

option.name: -b
tip: FTP bounce scan.

option.name: -D
tip: Cloak the scan with decoys.

option.name: -e
tip: Use the given network interface.

option.name: -f
tip: Fragment packets.
Repeat to use 16 bytes per fragment.

option.name: -F
tip: Fast mode: scan fewer ports than the default.

option.name: -iL
tip: Read target specifications from a file.

option.name: -iR
tip: Choose random targets.
The value is the number of IPs to generate.

option.name: -n
tip: Never perform reverse DNS resolution.

option.name: -O
tip: Enable OS detection.

option.name: -oA
tip: Store scan output in normal, XML, and grepable formats at once.

option.name: -oG
tip: Store scan output in grepable format.

option.name: -oN
tip: Store scan output in normal format.

option.name: -oS
tip: Store scan output in script kiddie format.

option.name: -oX
tip: Store scan output in XML format.

option.name: -p
tip: Scan only the given ports.
Accepts single ports, ranges, and protocol prefixes such as T: or U:.

option.name: -PA
tip: TCP ACK ping.
Append a port list to override the default port (e.g. -PA80).

option.name: -PE
tip: ICMP echo request ping.

option.name: -PM
tip: ICMP netmask request ping.

option.name: -Pn
tip: Treat all hosts as online and skip host discovery.

option.name: -PO
tip: IP protocol ping.
Append a protocol list to override the default protocol.

option.name: -PP
tip: ICMP timestamp request ping.

option.name: -PS
tip: TCP SYN ping.
Append a port list to override the default port (e.g. -PS22,80).

option.name: -PU
tip: UDP ping.
Append a port list to override the default port (e.g. -PU53).

option.name: -PY
tip: SCTP INIT ping.
Append a port list to override the default port.

option.name: -r
tip: Scan ports sequentially instead of randomizing them.

option.name: -R
tip: Always perform reverse DNS resolution on target addresses.

option.name: -S
tip: Spoof the source address.

option.name: -sA
tip: TCP ACK scan.

option.name: -sC
tip: Run the default set of NSE scripts.
Equivalent to --script default.

option.name: -sF
tip: TCP FIN scan.

option.name: -sI
tip: Idle scan through a zombie host.

option.name: -sL
tip: List scan: list targets without scanning them.

option.name: -sM
tip: TCP Maimon scan.

option.name: -sn
tip: Ping scan: disable port scan.
The legacy spelling -sP is still accepted.

option.name: -sN
tip: TCP NULL scan.

option.name: -sO
tip: IP protocol scan.

option.name: -sS
tip: TCP SYN scan (the default when privileged).

option.name: -sT
tip: TCP connect scan.

option.name: -sU
tip: UDP scan.

option.name: -sV
tip: Probe open ports to determine service and version information.

option.name: -sW
tip: TCP Window scan.

option.name: -sX
tip: TCP Xmas scan.

option.name: -sY
tip: SCTP INIT scan.

option.name: -sZ
tip: SCTP COOKIE ECHO scan.

option.name: -T
tip: Set a timing template.
Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, paranoid, sneaky, polite, normal, aggressive, insane.
